questions.question: What message did Jonah finally proclaim in Nineveh?
options: 'Build an altar, and offer your sacrifices to God'
'The LORD is gracious and full of compassion'
'Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!'
'Turn now, and the city shall be saved from ruin'
questions.answer: 'Yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown!'

questions.question: How did the people of Nineveh respond?
options: They mocked Jonah openly and drove him out of the city
They armed themselves at once and prepared for a great long war
They ignored the warning entirely and feasted on as before
They believed God, called a fast, and repented in sackcloth
questions.answer: They believed God, called a fast, and repented in sackcloth

questions.question: Even the king of Nineveh repented and called the people to turn from violence.
The people of Nineveh _____ God; they called for a fast and put on sackcloth.
When God saw that they turned from their evil way, he _____ of the disaster.
